guide.title: Lord of Mysteries Food and Beverage Guide
guide.source: Lord of Mysteries Wiki - Foods and Beverages

Rye_Bread.description: A staple among locals. It tends to be dry, dense, and occasionally sour. Best consumed soaked in water or alongside soups.

Lemon_Cake.description: Made with processed lemon peel crumbs. Has a delicate lemon scent and lingering, pleasant aftertaste. No bitter undertones.

Oyster_Soup.description: A beloved street snack. Premium quality and affordable. Served hot and freshly prepared.

Pan_Fried_Meat_and_Fish.description: A roadside stall delight. Freshly fried fish with distinctive flavor. Offal prepared onsite.

Timbale.description: A renowned Tingen specialty (pancake). Traditional production methods. Rich aroma and luxuriously dense cream. Best paired with sweet ice tea.

Meat_Pie.description: Soft, fluffy pudding-like body with rich custard aroma. Topped with roast beef. Unique blend of savory and sweet.

White_Bread.description: A luxury for affluent households. Soft, fluffy texture with buttery and milky flavor. Versatile – pairs with jam, used for sandwiches, or transformed into croutons.

Bean_and_Turnip_Bisque.description: A masterful blend of flavors. Turnips fried in butter, combined with beans and chicken stock. Seasoned with bay leaf, brandy, salt, white pepper, and chervil.

Beef_Stew_with_Potatoes.description: A quintessential Backlund dish. Upscale establishments use secret spices for enhanced flavor.

Deep_fried_Sailfish.description: A fish with a single spine, easy to eat. Traditionally paired with French fries. Modern twist: topped with sweet and sour or slightly spicy pepper sauce.

Potato_Pie.description: A dish from the southern regions.

Pork_filled_Pastries.description: A dish from the southern regions.

Caviar.description: Salted-cured roe. Luxurious quality and price. Appropriate mainly for formal dining.

Canned_Wolf_Fish.description: Popular on the east coast of Feysac Empire and the Gargas Archipelago. Pickled in salt, retains the blood. Smell is quite disgusting.

Desi_Pie.description: A baked wheat dough pie with a tiny bit of meat. Klein's favorite. Rich, meaty juice seeps into the crust. Contains crushed apples for a slightly sour and sweet taste.

Desi_Grilled_Fish.description: Roasted fish seasoned with basil, fennel, sea salt, pepper, and lemon juice.

Desi_Roasted_Meat.description: A large piece of golden-brown meat, glistening with oil. Seasoned with fennel, basil, and other spices.

Paella.description: Seafood paella. Very famous across Loen.

Feynapotter_Noodle.description: A famous dish sold all over Loen. Eaten with meat sauce. Resembles spaghetti bolognese.

Feynapotter_Pies.description: A common pie dish. A hand pie stuffed with fruits and ham.

Pork_Chops_with_Apple_Sauce.description: Fresh and juicy pork chops with a strong aroma. Apple sauce has a slightly acid taste, eliminating most of the greasiness.

Eggs_Benedict.description: A fatty fried egg with high caloric value. White fat transforms into a glistening, transparent grease. Sizzled to perfection in fresh meat oil. Crispy texture with tender egg liquid and crispy fried pork.

Cream_Soufflé.description: Freshly baked cakes resembling dense, fluffy clouds. Topped with cold cream. Ephemeral; loses its airy texture if left out too long.

Cat_Tongue_Cookies.description: Simple in appearance: flour, egg whites, butter, and powdered sugar. A masterful pastry chef creates a crispy, melt-in-your-mouth cookie with a delicate sweetness and milky aroma.

Mayonnaise_Bread.description: Soft, moist bread with a generous filling of creamy mayonnaise. The mayonnaise is crafted from cooked egg yolks, vegetable oil, lemon juice, and spices.

Smoked_Meat.description: Dariège bacon. Soft, chewy texture and distinctive smoky flavor. Smoked with special fruit woods and unique local spices.

Trout_Roll.description: A roll with freshly caught trout, cheese, and vegetables. Enhanced with lemon juice and herbs.

Teativa.description: Meat within fruit. A local food in Bayam. Teana fruit hollowed out and stuffed with mashed mutton and fish, sea salt, and spices. Roasted repeatedly.

Murloc_Meat.description: A Beyonder creature of the lowest grade. The most delicious part is its cheek. Suitable for eating raw.

Bansi_Harbors_Blood_Stew.description: Salted Blood Pudding with spicy sauce. Locals learned this dish from the elves.

Beluga_Meat.description: A sought-after delicacy. High fiber content and tough texture. Raw slices taste like medium-rare steak. Fried steak, roasted meat, and roasted whale skin (oily, burnt aroma) are popular.

Franks_Specialty_Foods.description: Extraordinary creations by Frank Lee. Includes an apple that looks, feels, and smells like an ordinary apple but cures illnesses. Also beef-flavored potatoes.

Grilled_Stickleback.description: Grilled fish enveloped in a special blend of straw-like spices from the Rorsted Archipelago. Eaten with chopsticks, inspired by elves.

Thick_Vegetable_Soup.description: Thick soup brewed with sweet vegetables, onions, cabbage, carrots, fish, and butter.

Damir_Special_Cured_Meat.description: A local delight in Damir Harbor. Dried in the gaps of a dead volcano, where the Spirit World interferes with reality. Ordinary people who eat it temporarily gain Spirit Vision.

Beef_Offal_Broth.description: A culinary delight in the Pas Valley. Tomatoes and onions with offal. Pepper counteracts the fishy scent. Includes crispy tripe, flexible beef intestines, and springy beef lungs.

Croissant_with_Cheese.description: Utilizes cassava flour. Soft, pliable consistency with a delightful springiness. Cheese filling mingles with the sweet aroma of baked grains and the rich essence of milk.

Grilled_Squid.description: Common in West Balam. Enormous deep-sea squid. Filling and affordable, but lacks flavor and has a tough texture.

Seafood_Bisque.description: At Star Plateau. A subtle fruity aroma with a hint of sweetness from palm oil. Chopped potatoes, mushrooms, and onions with clams, shrimp, and fish. Coconut milk and palm oil add richness.

Seared_Roasted_Meat.description: At the Haageti Plateau. Skewers of Haagenti's seared roasted meat. Diners eat directly from the iron rod. Hot juices cascade into their mouths.

Black_Faced_Grass_Bread.description: A bread made from Black Faced Grass. The staple food of the City of Silver. Resembles human hair. Said to be the final intervention of their god. Later revealed to be a product of a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, Gift of the Land.

Exotic_Creature_Meat.description: Meat from mutant monsters. Strange colors like metallic green, purple, and red. Foul odor resembling rotting fish.

Beef_Mushrooms.description: A mushroom believed to be bestowed by a great entity. Marbled exterior with a taste and texture akin to prime beef. Must be fully cooked.

Flour_Mushrooms.description: A golden mushroom with charming bright yellow star-shaped spots. Cannot be consumed raw. Baked whole or sliced until skin caramelizes. Crispy exterior with a firm yet soft and sweet texture reminiscent of real bread.

Milk_Mushrooms.description: A plump white mushroom from which milk can be extracted. Rich and creamy texture, surpassing traditional cow's milk.

Fish_Mushrooms.description: Fine-scaled mushroom. Offers a fragrant essence when grilled. Tender texture with a slight crispiness. No thorns found.

Sweet_Iced_Tea.description: A local beverage of Southern Loen. Stronger tea taste and more refreshing than iced black tea from Earth. Klein loves it but finds it too sweet for a gentleman.

Fermo_Coffee.description: A high-quality coffee bean from the Paz Valley on the Star Highlands of the Southern Continent. Highly bitter but rich in aroma with a splendid aftertaste.

Half_and_Half.description: One of the most popular alcoholic beverages in East Borough, Backlund. Made from equal proportions of malt beer and fortified grape wine.

Gurney_Sap.description: A locally-produced beverage of Symeem Island. Resembles lemonade with sugar and milk.

Golas_Beer.description: Popular along the eastern seaboard of the Feysac Empire. Black in color with plenty of foam. Pleasant charred taste with slight stimulation.

Zarhar.description: A locally-produced malt beer of Bayam. Cheap with a unique taste. Loved by adventurers.

Southville_Beer.description: The best beer produced in the Loen Kingdom from Southville county. White, smooth, and frothy. First bitter and fragrant, then the flavor of malt bursts out with a slightly sweet aftertaste.

Teana_Fruit_Juice.description: Slightly sweet milky fruit juice squeezed from the gigantic Teana fruit. A complementary drink in Teana Inn.

Lanti_Proof.description: The sailors' favorite alcohol. Strong distilled spirits made from pure malt. Cheap and has no other strengths besides its alcohol content.

Black_Rand.description: A locally-produced beverage of Bayam. Strong distilled wines mixed with other fermented grains. Unique to Loen.

Misty_Champagne.description: Golden champagne with minute bubbles like mist.

Aurmir_Grape_Wine.description: A red wine like blood. The most famous and most expensive grape wine in the Intis Republic. Made in Aurmir, the provincial capital of Champagne Province.

Sonia_Blood_Wine.description: Brewed from sugar-wood juice found in areas around Golden Spring, Sonia Island. Tastes like thin honey mixed with blood. Sweet and smooth, but very easy to get drunk on.

Nepos.description: A brownish-green distilled liquor, a specialty of the Feysac Empire. Brewed with potatoes or grain. High alcohol purity. Low price and well-liked by ordinary Feysacians.

Gwadar.description: A beverage made from a fruit native to West Balam. Orange-yellow in color. Sweet with a sourness. Good at quenching thirst and relieving heat. Contains some caffeine.

Fizzling_Ice_Tea.description: A signature non-alcoholic beverage of Utopia. Has a refreshing feeling. Especially delicious.

La_Fée_Verte_(Green_Fairy).description: Absinthe. Flavored distilled liquor, yellowish green in color. An alcohol trend in Trier. Main ingredients: wormwood, fennel, and anise.

Cœur_Épicé_(Spiced_Heart).description: A renowned fruit-based spirit distilled to perfection.

Kirsch.description: A distilled spirit made from sugar and fermented cherries. Has a color and texture that appeals to ladies. Other fruits can be substituted.

Venus_Sacred_Oil.description: Made from sugar and cinnamon water soaked in vanilla and mixed with poppies. Invented by a bar in Trier.

Whiskey_Sour.description: Low-quality alcohol brewed from apples. Only more expensive than some beer in taverns. Often hawked on the streets of the city.

Fennel_Absinthe.description: Another kind of absinthe. Flavors rich and invigorating with a subtle bitter note. Popular in Trier. Authors, painters, and poets are particularly fond of it.

Black_Poca.description: A pale-gold liquid aperitif from Trier. Brewed from ginger, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves soaked in sweet wine. Tastes pretty good.

Lover.description: An amber-hued, sweet alcohol. Made from a sugar alcohol brewed from sugarcane syrup. Served with ice and water. Common slang in Intis bars.

Ranger.description: A tangy blend of orange and pomegranate beer. Costs two licks more than the rye.

drink_slang.Little_Mummy: A small shot of fennel absinthe.
drink_slang.Somersault: A double shot of fennel absinthe.
drink_slang.Parrot: A Red Tomato mixed with mint.

mystic_travelers_gourmet_notes.description: Food-related information shared by the Lord of Mysteries Official Account on Weibo. No official English translation available yet.
